lines.text: In the Netherlands there are many organizations [organisaties] and associations/clubs [verenigingen] where you can be active in your free time:
Sports clubs [Sportverenigingen]: a football club, a swimming club, a gym.
Clubs for a hobby or cultural activity [culturele activiteit]: a dance school, photo club, hobby club, choir [koor], yoga school, theater.
Courses [Cursussen]: a language course, music course, cooking course, painting course.
Or a language café [taalcafé] in the library (usually free [gratis]), or an activity in a community center [buurthuis].
Places for your faith [geloof]: a church or mosque, where you can also meet [ontmoeten] people with the same religion.
You can become a member [lid], but you can also do volunteer work [vrijwilligerswerk] there.
Almost half of all people in the Netherlands do volunteer work somewhere.

Examples: trainer at a sports club, volunteer [vrijwilliger] at a church or mosque (visiting people), pouring/serving [schenken] coffee and tea in a community center, or helping at your child's school.
You can meet other people, practice the Dutch language, do something for others — and you get a network [netwerk].
A network can help you, for example when you go to apply for jobs [solliciteren].
